blurb: Guests ride pedal-powered Chessie Dragon boats seating up to 4 passengers or electric-powered Pirate Ships seating up to 6 passengers in Baltimore's Inner Harbor. The boats operate daily April through November, weather permitting, with safety orientations and life jackets provided. The experience is family-friendly and includes a designated paddling area within the harbor.
extraNote: No reservations; tickets sold first-come, first-served for immediate use · Last tickets sold 30 minutes before closing · Closed temporarily for heavy rain, strong wind, thunder, or lightning · Open through clouds and light rain without wind or electrical activity · No cash accepted; credit cards only (Visa, Mastercard, American Express) · If Baltimore City Health Dept issues Code Red Extreme Heat Alert, opening delayed until 4pm · Docks on either side of the World Trade Center in Baltimore's Inner Harbor · April through Labor Day; weekends in September and October
